text:
I paid only when an episode's watch window would otherwise be missed. With this plan, every follower sees every episode in time: 0 missed (episode, follower) pairs. There is no limit on concurrent services, so each service is planned on its own. Kestrel+ carries none of the followed titles, so it is never paid.

**Pebble Kids – 4 periods (the minimum):**
- The film Glass Tide is already covered by the access paid through 11-13.
- Nora's 1-day windows for The Paper Atlas run from 11-20 to 01-30. That is too long for two months, so it needs three periods:
  - 11-21 covers through 12-20.
  - 12-26 covers through 01-25.
  - 01-28 covers through 02-27, which also catches Velvet Circuit episodes 1–2.
- 03-05 covers through 04-04, which catches Velvet Circuit episodes 3–7.
- No single period can reach both The Paper Atlas's end and Velvet Circuit's 04-02 episode, so 4 is the fewest possible.

**Orbit – 2 periods:**
- 01-21 covers through 02-20. It catches Salt Tide episodes 1–6 and the Silver Lantern drop (window 01-29 to 02-05).
- 03-04 covers through 04-03. It catches Salt Tide episodes 7–9.
- One period cannot reach both 01-21 and 03-11.

**Lumen – 2 periods:**
- Episode 1 of The Silver Circuit is covered by the existing access (paid through 11-14).
- 11-21 covers through 12-20, catching episodes 2–7.
- 12-26 covers through 01-25, catching episodes 8–12.

**Tidewell – 1 period:**
- Northern Atlas episodes 1–2 are covered by the existing access (paid through 11-28).
- 12-01 covers through 12-31, catching episodes 3–7.

**Marquee – 3 periods:**
- Nora must watch The Quiet Garden on 12-30 or 12-31, while Rosa's window for Silver Kingdom episode 12 needs access on or after 01-31. A second period starting on or before 12-31 can't reach 01-31, so two periods would miss a pair; three are needed.
- 11-22 covers through 12-21, catching episodes 1–6.
- 12-27 covers through 01-26, catching episodes 7–11 and The Quiet Garden.
- 01-31 catches episode 12.

That is 12 paid periods in total, costing $135.71 (13,571 cents).
